Maya (AE): Aurora Dataworks confirmed a 48h joint pilot next week. They want per-route throttles, sampling-based telemetry, and a simple pricing comparison Dedicated vs hosted. Also a short answer for their security questionnaire about SAML/SCIM.
Diego (Partner Eng): Thanks. Who's owning the entitlement map + routing?
Maya (AE): @Ivy can you own the entitlement map + runbook? I'll coordinate with Aurora PM on scoping.
Ivy (Solutions): Happy to. Need to know expected mix: mostly embedding lookups + short chat completions, or long context generation?
Aurora PM (via Diego): Mostly embeddings for vector search (~100 qps) and chat for UI assist (~50 rps), 2k token average, occasional spikes to 6k.
Rishi (Infra): For that pattern recommend a small Dedicated reserve (1-2 GPU equiv) with autoscale to hosted for spikes. We should pre-define per-route caps: embeddings route 120 qps, chat route 80 rps, with burst tokens/sec limits.
Leah (Security): On SAML/SCIM: we support SAML SSO for Console and SCIM for provisioning. For pilot we'll provide delegated provisioning via short-lived SCIM token and a scoped SAML assertion. I'll prepare the boilerplate answers.
Maya (AE): They also asked about telemetry retention and whether we can provide a sampled stream to their Splunk.
Ivy (Solutions): We can do telemetry sampling at 1% default and escalate to 10% for flagged routes. We'll include a sample config for Prometheus scrape + event forwarder.
Rishi (Infra): Quick sample for routed policy (draft):
```
route: /v1/embeddings -> dedicated-pool (cap 120qps, batch_size 64)
route: /v1/chat -> dedicated-pool (cap 80rps, fallback hosted after 100ms queue)
fallback: hosted (priority low)
telemetry: sample 0.01 -> forward splunk://aurora-ingest
```
Diego (Partner Eng): For entitlements we'll issue two API keys: pilot-admin (controls rollouts) and ingest-only (telemetry + embeddings). Keys will be time-limited to the pilot dates.
Aurora PM (via Diego): Pricing ask: can you give a back-of-envelope monthly $ for Dedicated reserve vs hosted for this workload?
Rishi (Infra): Ballpark numbers: Dedicated baseline (1x A100-eq) commit ~$35k/mo; if they want 2x for headroom ~$65k/mo. Hosted pay-as-you-go for the same traffic ~1.5x-2x of Dedicated depending on seq length due to long context. Also factor in egress and telemetry export costs.
Ivy (Solutions): Note: embeddings batch sizing can drastically change unit costs. Recommend batching window 40-80ms for embeddings to keep latency < 100ms while saving tokens.
Leah (Security): Security questionnaire highlights: SOC2 yes, encryption in transit TLS1.2+, at-rest encryption with customer-managed KMS in Private; we do periodic key rotation (90 day cadence recommended). We can provide a signed ATO-like packet for enterprise buyers.
partner-bot: Tenant creation: aurora-pilot-2026 queued by Maya at 1766010005.
Rishi (Infra): Provisioned tenant aur-pilot-81, VPC peering created. Added egress rule and telemetry endpoint allowlist.
Ivy (Solutions): I'll post the entitlement matrix and a short runbook for onboarding (accounts, keys, sample curl). Example curl for embedding call with batch param: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <INGEST_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["..."],"batch_ms":50}'
```
Diego (Partner Eng): Aurora asked if we support quantized model variants to reduce cost. Short answer: yes on Dedicated and Private; hosted offers lower-cost quantized variants on request but needs compatibility check.
Maya (AE): Action list: Ivy - entitlement matrix + runbook. Rishi - capacity calc + peering snippet. Leah - security Q answers and SCIM token template. Diego - prepare pilot API key rotation plan. I'll present numbers to Aurora execs tomorrow 11am PT.
partner-bot: Tenant aur-pilot-81: VPC peering established at 1766010500.
Rishi (Infra): Capacity calc posted: https://redwood.internal/sheets/aurora-capacity (draft). Uses 95th percentile from their loadprofile.
Ivy (Solutions): Entitlement matrix shared: https://redwood.internal/docs/aurora-entitlements (comments welcomed).
Leah (Security): Security answers uploaded: https://redwood.internal/security/aurora-qna (redacted).
Diego (Partner Eng): Added runbook link with fallback policy examples and routing JSON: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aurora-pilot (draft).
Maya (AE): Thanks team. Please flag any blockers with :rotating_light:. We'll keep this thread for short updates only.
Ivy (Solutions): One blocker from Aurora infra: they require mutual TLS for telemetry. Can Leah confirm if we can mutual TLS their ingest endpoint?
Leah (Security): We support mTLS for telemetry push; need cert exchange and CA details. I'll DM Aurora contact and add steps to the runbook.
Maya (AE): Great, meeting invite sent.
Diego (Partner Eng): I'll hand off the short-lived API keys the morning of the pilot.
Ivy (Solutions): Closing note: embedding batching knob + per-route caps will be the biggest lever on cost during the pilot.
